resources.string: Prepare your optional TMDB connection for movie and show details. Your local library and playback work without it.
Artwork and matching are being connected to the library. Saving this connection does not start a library lookup in this build.
When enabled, Player may send normalized titles, year and media type directly to api.themoviedb.org and fetch artwork from image.tmdb.org.
Your videos, subtitles, folder names, file paths and original filenames stay on your device. Disabling metadata keeps your local library available.
Use your own TMDB API Read Access Token. Player encrypts it on this device and excludes it from app backup.
Paste a token from your TMDB account
Leave this field empty to keep the saved token. Player never displays it again.
Saved token and metadata consent removed.
Player could not open or save this connection. Metadata is disabled. Remove the saved connection, then enter your token again.
Enter a valid API Read Access Token without spaces or line breaks.
